Lahore, Gulberg Block B mein paani bohat ganda aa raha hai, peenay ke qabil hi nahi hai. Mere bachay beemar ho gaye hain, filtration plant ka koi checkup nahi hota kya?
Rawalpindi Saddar Bazaar ki main pipeline mein aik haftay se leakage hai. Sadak par paani phaila hua hai aur waste ho raha hai. Isko theek karwain please.
Islamabad G-9/2 mein paani ki supply regular nahi. Majbooran humein private tankers se paani lena parta hai jo bohat mehnga dete hain. Yeh tanker mafia kab khatam hoga?
Peshawar Hayatabad Phase 4 mein humara tube well kharab ho gaya hai aur department koi action nahi le raha. Ghar mein paani ka masla bana hua hai.
Faisalabad Samanabad mein shaam ke time paani ka pressure bohat kam hota hai. Kapray dhonay aur bartan saaf karnay mein bohat mushkil hoti hai.
Multan Shah Rukn-e-Alam Colony mein mere paani ke bill mein ghalat units show ho rahe hain. Please isko check kar ke durust kar den. Shukriya.
Quetta Jinnah Town mein kal raat se paani nahi aa raha. Yahan par buzurgh afraad hain jinhein subah wazu aur nahane mein takleef ho rahi hai. Jaldi supply restore karen.
Karachi Lyari mein paani ke saath gutter ka paani mix ho kar aa raha hai. Log beemar ho rahe hain aur yeh zindagi ka masla hai. Agar koi bara masla ho gaya toh kon zimmedar hoga?
Lahore Bahria Town Sector C mein new connection ke liye apply kiye hue 2 mahine ho gaye hain. Abhi tak koi response nahi mila. Bohat takleef ho rahi hai.
Islamabad F-8/4 mein main water line burst ho gayi hai aur 24 ghantay se paani zaya ho raha hai. Please isko jaldi repair karwain, yeh to public property ka nuksan hai.
Rawalpindi Adiala Road par humne kal water tanker book kiya tha, abhi tak nahi aaya. Saaray ghar ka kaam ruka hua hai. Please follow up karein.
Peshawar University Road par hamare area ka filter plant kafi dinon se theek se kaam nahi kar raha. Paani ka taste change ho gaya hai.
Faisalabad Jhang Road near bypass mein bohat dirty paani aa raha hai, bilkul peenay ke qabil nahi. Mere chotay bachay ko motion lag gaye hain is paani se. Kya karun mein?
Multan Mumtazabad mein pichle paanch din se nalkha sukha hua hai. Subah se sham tak pani ka wait karte rehte hain lekin supply nahi aati.
Quetta Satellite Town mein paani ki supply timings bohat erratic hain. Kabhi subah aa jata hai, kabhi dopahar ko. Humein apna schedule adjust karne mein mushkil hoti hai.
Karachi North Nazimabad Block H mein hamara water meter kharab ho gaya hai aur bill theek nahi aa raha. Baraye meherbani aakar check kar den.
Lahore Ichhra mein hamare mohalley ki purani pipeline leak kar rahi hai aur pressure bhi kam hai. Humari gali mein nayi pipeline ki zaroorat hai.
Islamabad I-10/1 mein paani ka pressure bilkul zero hai. Subah se paani nahi hai ghar mein. Elderly parents ko nahane mein bohat masla ho raha hai. SHAME on you guys!
Rawalpindi Chaklala Scheme III main road par 2 din se ek choti si leakage hai. Paani road par jama ho raha hai. Kya aap isko repair karwa sakte hain?
Peshawar Warsak Road par hamare area ka boring pump kharab ho gaya hai, jiski wajah se humein paani nahi mil raha. Please isko theek karwain warna hum pani ke baghair mar jayenge.
Faisalabad Madina Town mein shaam ke waqt paani ka pressure itna kam ho jata hai ke upper floors par paani nahi charhta. Daily ka routine affect ho raha hai.
Karachi Malir mein paani ki supply bohat kam hai aur jo aata hai woh bhi smell wala hota hai. Tanker ka rate itna high hai ke affordable nahi hai. Yeh zulm hai!
Lahore Township mein filtration plant ki safai theek se nahi hoti. Pani se ajeeb si smell aati hai aur kabhi kabhi us mein mitti bhi hoti hai. Mera poora ghar is paani se beemar hai.
Islamabad G-11/3 mein pichle poore hafta paani nahi aaya. Customer service par call karo toh koi phone nahi uthata. Humari family ko bohat mushkilaat ka saamna hai.

Karachi DHA Phase 6 mein bohat zyaada load shedding ho rahi hai. Koi schedule follow nahi ho raha, din mein 10-12 ghante bijli gayab rehti hai. Bachon ki online classes aur sardi mein heater bhi nahi chal rahe. Bohut tang aa gaye hain.

Humare Rawalpindi, Satellite Town mein transformer phatt gaya hai 3 din pehle. Tab se light nahi hai. Mere walidain bohut buzurg hain, unki medicines fridge mein kharab ho rahi hain. Koi sunwai nahi ho rahi.
Lahore Gulberg III mein meter ka bill itna zyada aaya hai ke samajh nahi aa raha. Pata nahi konsi ghalti hui hai, usage toh hamari bohat kam hai. Lagta hai meter theek se reading nahi de raha.

Peshawar, Hayatabad Phase 4 mein voltage itni low aati hai ke fridge, AC, aur UPS kuch bhi theek se charge nahi ho rahe. Sare appliances kharab ho rahe hain. KESC ko complaint ki hai, koi action nahi.

Multan Cantt mein humne ek mahina pehle new commercial connection ke liye apply kiya tha. Abhi tak meter install nahi hua. Humara business start karne mein delay ho raha hai, barae meherbani jaldi karain.

Faisalabad, Ghulam Muhammad Abad mein school ke paas poles se nange taar latak rahe hain. Bachay khelte hain aur current lagne ka khatra hai. Please isko theek karwain warna koi bara hadsa ho sakta hai.
Hyderabad Latifabad Unit No. 7 mein meter reader kabhi ghar nahi aata. Har baar estimated bill bhej dete hain jo hamesha ghalat hota hai. Hum accurate billing chahte hain.
Islamabad G-9/2 mein last 10 ghante se light gayab hai. Garmi se bachon ka bura haal hai aur paani bhi khatam ho raha hai. IESCO walay phone bhi nahi utha rahe.
Lahore Bahria Town mein humara bill aaya hai usmein previous owner ke arrears show ho rahe hain. Jabke humne ownership transfer karwa li thi. Please isko correct kar ke naya bill bhejen.
Anarkali, Lahore mein aik transformer mein se spark nikal rahe hain aur loud awaazain aa rahi hain. Lag raha hai ke ye kisi bhi waqt blast ho sakta hai. Yeh bohat dangerous hai!
Karachi Gulshan-e-Iqbal Block 5 mein pichle 10 din se street lights nahi chal rahin. Raat mein bohat andhera rehta hai aur security ka masla ho raha hai. Please iski repair karwain.
Rawalpindi Saddar mein humara electricity meter chori ho gaya tha. Humne police report bhi karwai hai, lekin IESCO se replacement ka koi response nahi mila. 5 din ho gaye hain bijli ke baghair.
Islamabad F-8/1 mein bijli ka current bohat fluctuate karta hai. Kabhi low voltage, kabhi high. Humare ghar ke electronics jal gaye hain, aur ab TV bhi kharab ho gaya hai. Pls isko theek karain.
Peshawar University Town mein mere apartment ka bill itna zyada aaya hai jabke main pichle do mahine se ghar mein nahi tha. Zero unit consumption honi chahiye thi. Lagta hai meter reading ghalat hai.
Faisalabad Jhang Road per hamare locality mein illegal kunda connections bohat zyada ho gaye hain. Iski wajah se voltage bar bar drop ho jati hai aur bijli ki supply bhi disturb rehti hai.
Multan DHA Phase 2 mein rozana 6-7 baar bijli chali jaati hai, har baar adhe ghante ke liye. UPS bhi charge nahi ho pata. Yeh kya mazak hai? Koi solution nikalo.
Hyderabad Qasimabad mein paani ki motoren nahi chal rahin kyunki voltage bohat kam hai. Garmi ki wajah se paani ka masla bohat serious ho gaya hai. Please voltage theek karain.
Lahore WAPDA Town mein WAPDA bill payment center pichle 2 din se down hai. Hum apna bill pay nahi kar pa rahe aur late payment charges lag jayenge. Kindly system theek karwain.
Karachi Nazimabad mein aik bara darakht power lines ko touch kar raha hai. Hawa chalne per taaron mein ragad paida hoti hai aur spark nikalte hain. Barish mein current lagne ka khatra hai.

Rawalpindi Gulraiz Colony mein hamare mohalle ka main fuse box bar bar ud jata hai. Electrician aata hai theek karta hai phir ud jata hai. Koi permanent solution provide karein, har dosre din andhera rehta hai.
Islamabad I-10/4 mein thori si barish hoti hai toh bijli ghanton ke liye chali jaati hai. Yeh har barish ka routine ban gaya hai, hamari routine kharab ho rahi hai.
Lahore Defence Phase 7 mein meter reader sirf photo leke chala jata hai, reading note nahi karta. Har mahine estimated bill aata hai. Is ghalti ki wajah se hamara bill incorrect hota hai.
Multan Bosan Road per hamare gali ka transformer bohat zor se hum karta hai aur garmiyon mein over-heat ho jata hai. Barae meherbani isko check karwain, kahin koi bara masla na ho jaye.
Peshawar Nothia mein aik bijli ke khambe se nikalta hua taar neeche latka hua hai. Kal aik chote bachay ko halka sa current laga hai khelte huye. Yeh zindagi ka masla hai, urgent theek karain.
